Full faithfulness is the P4 bijection compatible with identities and composition; essential surjectivity is the theorem’s converse; the functor side is locally small by the category lemma and the bimodule side is locally small because Hom-collections of maps between sets are sets. Kamensky Cor 5.1.48 and Nyman–Smith Theorem 1.2 record the same equivalence, including composition of functors corresponding to ⊗ of bimodules.
